findings: The word 'conjecture' occurs ZERO times in the full text. No statement, resolution, subsumption, or counterexample of MF arXiv:1501.02939v1 Conjecture 2.16 (first or second clause) appears anywhere.

MF's paper is cited exactly once, as [19], in 'The problem of squaring operator inequalities has been studied extensively... We refer the reader to [12,16,19] as sample of this work.' Reference [19] reads 'M.S. Moslehian and X. Fu, Squaring operator Polya-Szego and Diaz-Metcalf type inequalities, Linear Algebra Appl. 490 (2016), 73-82.' (volume misprinted 490 for 491 in the accepted manuscript). No content of [19] is used.

ALL squared results in the paper run in the REVERSE-AM-GM (Lin) direction, bounding the squared map of an ARITHMETIC-type mean: Corollary 2.5: Phi(A nabla B) <= K(h) Phi(A sharp B) and (2.14) Phi^2(A nabla B) <= K^2(h) (Phi(A) sharp Phi(B))^2 with K(h)=(h+1)^2/4h, h=M/m; the squared version of their Theorem 2.1: Phi^2(A nabla_v B) <= K(h) ((m nabla_lambda M)/(m sharp_lambda M))^2 (Phi(A) sharp_v Phi(B))^2; (2.15) Phi^2(A nabla_v B) <= K^2(h) Phi^2(A sharp_v B); Proposition 2.3: Phi^2(A nabla_v B) <= C Phi^2(A sharp_v B) and Phi^2(A nabla_v B) <= C (Phi(A) sharp_v Phi(B))^2 with C=min{K(M/m)((m nabla_lambda M)/(m sharp_lambda M))^2, K^2(M/m)}. (Note this manuscript's own '(2.16)' is the scalar lemma f(alpha t) <= alpha f(t) - unrelated to MF's Conjecture 2.16.)

The TARGET direction - (Phi(A) sharp Phi(B))^2 <= alpha^2 Phi(A sharp B)^2, i.e. bounding the squared geometric mean of images BY the squared image of the geometric mean - appears nowhere, and nothing in the paper implies it: their squaring method (Lemma 2.1, Kantorovich constant) exploits the unital-map identity Phi(A nabla B) = Phi(A) nabla Phi(B), which has no analogue for the sharp direction; their positive-map inequality (1.6) (with sigma_v, tau_v between ! and nabla) is never squared in the target's direction.
No counterexample to the first clause (or any numerical negative example) exists in the paper.

The paper's own topic (sharper constant (m nabla_lambda M)/(m sharp_lambda M) for reverse AM-GM, operator monotone f comparisons f(A) sharp_v f(B) <= c f(A sharp_v B) (2.17), Golden-Thompson reverse) is orthogonal to the target; nothing overlaps the conjectured sharpening.
